summary: The old harness cannot select PEDANTIC_WHITESPACE, so it cannot exercise retention of whitespace-only text before a closing tag on either source version.

assessment.necessity_reason: For <r>  </r>, PEDANTIC_WHITESPACE creates a text node from the spaces before </r>. The harness always constructs the document with the default PRESERVE_WHITESPACE mode. Input bytes cannot change that constructor choice, and the default path skips those spaces.

before.requirement: Parse an element with PEDANTIC_WHITESPACE selected and retain its whitespace-only text immediately before the closing tag.
before.reason: The pedantic path is supported, but the harness constructs only a default-mode document.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Declares PEDANTIC_WHITESPACE as a selectable mode.
The document constructor defaults to PRESERVE_WHITESPACE.
The selected change group concerns cleanup of parsed child nodes.

after.requirement: Parse an element with PEDANTIC_WHITESPACE selected and retain its whitespace-only text immediately before the closing tag.
after.reason: The pedantic path remains supported; the same harness still fixes the document to the default mode.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Declares PEDANTIC_WHITESPACE as a selectable mode.
The document constructor defaults to PRESERVE_WHITESPACE.
The changed destructor cleans up parsed child nodes.

assessment.comparison_reason: The same default-only document construction prevents selection of PEDANTIC_WHITESPACE on both sides. The parser condition for retaining the whitespace text is unchanged.
